name: CI
trigger: push or pull request to main

journey.detail: Run repository All gates and collect actual results.
Retain raw findings; analysis policy determines admission, independently of report upload.
Dagger generates the container analysis inputs. No public release promotion occurs in CI.

name: Release

journey.detail: Produce all artifacts upfront and enforce tests, scans, SBOM and schema gates; GoReleaser skips publication. Export the complete payload and initial manifest.
Use the existing actions/attest-build-provenance GitHub OIDC identity. Signing configuration is not successful verification.
Verify exact payload manifest, repository, release.yml identity, source SHA and tag; render final site bytes and final release manifest.
Attest the final immutable manifest; retain its detached bundle outside the covered payload.
Verify expected identity and every final payload/site digest. Missing mandatory proof or altered bytes blocks promotion.
Only after all gates pass, publish exact release assets and the verified OCI bytes; stage the exact site for Pages. No unsigned fallback or post-signing rewriting.

produces: six SDK bundles and supported packages

journey.detail: Consume the release’s existing site bytes, inventory and detached proofs; do not rebuild from mutable main or merge latest assets.
Recheck hosted identity and all exact bytes before publication. Incomplete proof stops this journey.
Deploy the verified site bundle without rewriting links, evidence or final signed bytes.

name: OSCAL Reconcile
trigger: every six hours or manual dispatch

journey.detail: Use repository reconciliation scripts to identify drift and operational errors.
Open a draft PR when authorized by the workflow; human review remains required. Drift detection is not a release signature.
